title: A done refused only because the item's code commits are not yet on the integration main opens no rework window in backlog.py cost
goal: A backlog.py done refused only for the code-lane order (its one reason unlanded-code: the item's code commits are not yet on the integration main, the code/<id> merge request still to merge) is no rework: the work row the capture writes for it (ql_capture.refused_done), or rework_windows in ql_distill, opens no rework window for the item, so backlog.py cost --rework does not count the prompts after it (the orchestrator's landing) as the item's rework; a done refused for any other reason (a failed check, outside touches, no work commit) still opens one. No error text is stored. Planted check: a real done in a planted repo refused for unlanded code, and another refused for a failed check, both replayed through ql_capture.capture into a temporary spool; rework_windows has only the second in rework at a later prompt. From the SP-hyp6o7hl retrospective.

run:
import json,os,shutil,subprocess as sp,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
S=Path.cwd();t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());d=t/'r';q=t/'data';c=1
os.environ.update(CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=str(S),CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA=str(q))
try:
    b=d/'kb'/'_self'/'backlog';b.mkdir(parents=True);(d/'_tools').mkdir();(d/'kb'/'pub').mkdir()
    g=lambda *a:sp.run(['git','-C',str(d),'-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@example.com',*a],capture_output=True,check=True)
    g('init','-q','-b','main')
    W=lambda p,s:Path(d/p).write_text(s)
    it=lambda i,tch,ck:{'id':i,'kind':'bug','title':'T','status':'doing','priority':'P3','rank':0,'severity':'S3','goal':'g','repro':{'run':['python3','-c','pass']},'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c',ck]}],'touches':[tch]}
    W('kb/_self/backlog/BG-aaaaaaaa.json',json.dumps(it('BG-aaaaaaaa','_tools/x.py','pass')));W('kb/_self/backlog/BG-bbbbbbbb.json',json.dumps(it('BG-bbbbbbbb','kb/pub/a.md','import sys;sys.exit(1)')))
    W('_tools/x.py','x=1\n');W('kb/pub/a.md','a\n');g('add','-A');g('commit','-qm','base');g('update-ref','refs/remotes/origin/main','HEAD')
    W('_tools/x.py','x=2\n');g('commit','-qam','fix\n\nKB-Work: BG-aaaaaaaa')
    W('kb/pub/a.md','b\n');g('commit','-qam','doc\n\nKB-Work: BG-bbbbbbbb')
    sys.path.insert(0,str(S/'_tools'));import ql_capture,ql_distill
    def h(p,ev,cmd,**k):ql_capture.capture(dict(hook_event_name=ev,session_id='s1',prompt_id=p,tool_name='Bash',tool_input=dict(command=cmd),**k))
    def done(i,p):
        r=sp.run([sys.executable,str(S/'_tools'/'backlog.py'),'--root',str(d),'done',i],capture_output=True,text=True)
        print(i,'done exit',r.returncode,(r.stdout+r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-1:])
        h(p,'PostToolUseFailure','python3 _tools/backlog.py done '+i,error='Exit code %d\n%s%s'%(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr))
        return r.returncode
    for i,p in (('BG-aaaaaaaa','p1'),('BG-bbbbbbbb','p1')):h(p,'PostToolUse','python3 _tools/backlog.py claim '+i,tool_response=dict(stdout='ok'))
    ra=done('BG-aaaaaaaa','p2');rb=done('BG-bbbbbbbb','p3')
    rows=[json.loads(x) for x in (q/'querylog'/'spool'/'s1.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]+[{'prompt_id':'p4','surface':'prompt'}]
    w=ql_distill.rework_windows(rows);print('rework at p4:',sorted(w.get('p4',())))
    R=[ra!=0,rb!=0,'BG-aaaaaaaa' not in w.get('p4',()),'BG-bbbbbbbb' in w.get('p4',())];print(R);c=0 if all(R) else 1
except Exception as x:print('check error',type(x).__name__,str(x)[:200])
finally:shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
sys.exit(c)

notes: Premise: the item's check (a planted done refused for unlanded code, replayed through ql_capture.capture, then ql_distill.rework_windows) shows the item in rework at the later prompt (exit 1, [True, True, False, True]) on 2026-10-06; in SP-hyp6o7hl the worker's done of BG-dudqrf5p was refused only for the lane order and cost --rework counted the orchestrator's landing (4.59M tokens) as its rework. Second clause, not checked here: the worktree subagents' usage read 0 attributed (sub) for their items; ST-spywrqpp carries the worktree spool side of it, and what is left (routing a worktree subagent's usage to its item) is for this story's worker to file once that lands. The rework window starts at ql_distill.rework_windows from the work row action refused that ql_capture.refused_done writes for a done exiting 1; done's reason classes are in the done.refused ops row (bl_land.refuse_done), which carries no prompt id.
